id: \bThe Bug Catching Contest only takes place on Tuesday, Thursday, or Saturday.
en: \bThe Bug Catching Contest only takes place on Tuesday, Thursday, or Saturday.
it: \bLa Gara di Cattura Insetti si tiene solo di martedì, giovedì o sabato.

id: \bThe Pokémon you find in the National Park change depending on if you're competing. Please talk to the man next to me if you want to play.
en: \bThe Pokémon you find in the National Park change depending on if you're competing. Please talk to the man next to me if you want to play.
it: \bI Pokémon che trovi nel Parco Nazionale cambiano a seconda che tu stia gareggiando o no. Parla con l'uomo accanto a me se vuoi partecipare.

id: \bWe hope you'll take part in a Bug-Catching Contest in the future!
en: \bWe hope you'll take part in a Bug-Catching Contest in the future!
it: \bSperiamo che parteciperai a una Gara di Cattura Insetti in futuro!

id: \bToday's \v[1].
en: \bToday's \v[1].
it: \bOggi è \v[1].

id: \bThat means the Bug-Catching Contest is on today.
en: \bThat means the Bug-Catching Contest is on today.
it: \bQuindi oggi si tiene la Gara di Cattura Insetti.

id: \bThe rules are simple.
en: \bThe rules are simple.
it: \bLe regole sono semplici.

id: \bUsing one of your Pokémon, catch a Bug-type Pokémon to be judged.
en: \bUsing one of your Pokémon, catch a Bug-type Pokémon to be judged.
it: \bUsando uno dei tuoi Pokémon, cattura un Pokémon di tipo Coleottero che verrà giudicato.

id: \bWould you like to give it a try?
en: \bWould you like to give it a try?
it: \bVuoi provare?

id: \bSorry, your PC boxes are full.
en: \bSorry, your PC boxes are full.
it: \bMi dispiace, i tuoi Box del PC sono pieni.

id: \bYou are only allowed to take 1 Pokémon into the Contest.
en: \bYou are only allowed to take 1 Pokémon into the Contest.
it: \bPuoi portare solo 1 Pokémon alla Gara.

id: \bPlease choose which Pokémon you want to enter with.
en: \bPlease choose which Pokémon you want to enter with.
it: \bScegli con quale Pokémon vuoi partecipare.

id: \bOK. We hope you'll take part in the future.
en: \bOK. We hope you'll take part in the future.
it: \bOK. Speriamo che parteciperai in futuro.

id: \bYou will be entering with \v[2], then.
en: \bYou will be entering with \v[2], then.
it: \bParteciperai con \v[2], allora.

id: \bWe'll hold your other Pokémon while you compete.
en: \bWe'll hold your other Pokémon while you compete.
it: \bTerremo noi gli altri tuoi Pokémon mentre gareggi.

id: \PN's Pokémon were left with the Contest Helper.\se[Pkmn exp full]\wtnp[20]
en: \PN's Pokémon were left with the Contest Helper.\se[Pkmn exp full]\wtnp[20]
it: \PN ha lasciato i suoi Pokémon all'assistente della Gara.\se[Pkmn exp full]\wtnp[20]

id: \bHere are the Sport Balls for the Contest.
en: \bHere are the Sport Balls for the Contest.
it: \bEcco le Gara Ball per la Gara.

id: \PN received 20 Sport Balls.\me[Item get]\wtnp[40]
en: \PN received 20 Sport Balls.\me[Item get]\wtnp[40]
it: \PN ha ricevuto 20 Gara Ball.\me[Item get]\wtnp[40]

id: \bThe person who gets the strongest bug Pokémon is the winner.
en: \bThe person who gets the strongest bug Pokémon is the winner.
it: \bVince chi cattura il Pokémon Coleottero più forte.

id: \bYou have 20 minutes.
en: \bYou have 20 minutes.
it: \bHai 20 minuti.

id: \bIf you run out of Sport Balls, you're done.
en: \bIf you run out of Sport Balls, you're done.
it: \bSe finisci le Gara Ball, hai finito.

id: \bYou can keep the last Pokémon you catch as your own.
en: \bYou can keep the last Pokémon you catch as your own.
it: \bPuoi tenere l'ultimo Pokémon che catturi.

id: \bGo out and catch the strongest Bug-type Pokémon you can find!
en: \bGo out and catch the strongest Bug-type Pokémon you can find!
it: \bVai e cattura il Pokémon di tipo Coleottero più forte che riesci a trovare!

id: \bWe hold contests regularly in the Park. You should give it a shot.
en: \bWe hold contests regularly in the Park. You should give it a shot.
it: \bOrganizziamo regolarmente delle gare nel Parco. Dovresti provare.

id: \bYou still have some time left. Do you want to finish now?
en: \bYou still have some time left. Do you want to finish now?
it: \bTi resta ancora un po' di tempo. Vuoi finire adesso?

id: \bOK. Please wait in the pavillion for the announcement of the winners.
en: \bOK. Please wait in the pavillion for the announcement of the winners.
it: \bOK. Attendi nel padiglione l'annuncio dei vincitori.

id: \bOK. Please go back outside and finish up.
en: \bOK. Please go back outside and finish up.
it: \bOK. Torna fuori e finisci.
